description: This file defines an interface named CommandRegistry within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.base package. The interface extends JsonParsableRegistry and is parameterized with a Command type, serving as a registry capable of parsing Command instances from JSON objects.

classes.name: CommandRegistry
classes.description: A registry interface for Command objects, capable of parsing commands from JSON.
